description: Oil and Gas Pipelines of Australia is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. This data set contains information on Oil and Gas pipeline infrastructure. This dataset has been converted from Microstation format used in a map "Petroleum Exploration and Development Titles" published annually in APRIL. Attributes have been added to comply with data standards and minor coding of line work has been achieved using annotation from the map. Coverage: Australia. The portal lists 15 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are AU, National dataset, Petroleum Data, Petroleum and Coal Geology, Published_External. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, ZIP. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
